metadata.title: Application Session and State Management

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for maintaining correct identity, privilege, and execution context across application interactions.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Application sessions, cookies, tokens, state stores, caches, and contextual execution data.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for governing identity- and privilege-bearing application state over time.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Session management assumes baseline application purpose, ownership, and lifecycle governance.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Session continuity depends on prior establishment of actor identity and authorization context.

metadata.remarks: Application Session and State Management defines trust properties required to preserve identity, privilege, and execution context across requests. This pattern addresses session fixation, privilege carry-over, stale state, and context confusion without addressing input validation or data access rules.

components.title: Session Establishment and Binding
components.description: Binds application sessions securely to authenticated actors and execution context.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Use of valid credentials combined with session manipulation to gain unauthorized access.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Masquerading through stolen or reused session identifiers.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Strong binding of session identifiers to authenticated identity.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Application sessions are bound to authenticated identity context.

components.title: Session Lifecycle and Expiration
components.description: Ensures sessions are created, refreshed, and terminated appropriately.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Persistence through stale or non-expiring application sessions.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Lifecycle management of session state to reduce residual risk.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Session lifetime and renewal are constrained to reduce misuse.

components.title: Privilege Consistency and State Isolation
components.description: Prevents privilege escalation or leakage through shared or mutable state.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Privilege escalation through manipulation of persistent or shared session state.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Access control and isolation of privilege-bearing state.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Application state enforces least privilege across execution contexts.

components.title: Session Observability and Audit
components.description: Provides visibility into session creation, use, and termination.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Suppression of evidence related to session misuse or hijacking.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Audit logging of session lifecycle events.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Session lifecycle events are logged by the application.
Audit review supports detection of session abuse.
